source.stem: The diagram shows a quadrilateral on a 1 cm² grid.

parts.text: Write down the mathematical name of this quadrilateral. [1]
Work out the area of this quadrilateral. Give the units of your answer. [3]

hinge.title: Choose numbers so that exactly the intended cells become supercells.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Intended supercell is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Choose numbers so that exactly the intended cells become supercells' is answered as intended supercell rather than chosen number.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Intended supercell is what produces chosen number, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Choose numbers so that exactly the intended cells.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: chosen number is settled by running 'Apply the reverse-and-add process and stop at the correct time': Start with a 2-digit number, add it to its reverse, and repeat reversing and adding until — on the item about Choose numbers so that exactly the intended cells.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Chosen number is computed by squaring intended supercell and leaving chosen number linear, so the written value is 57 — on the item about Choose numbers so that exactly the intended cells.

intelligence.enrichment: To make a cell a supercell, its number must be greater than each immediate neighbour; to keep a cell from being a supercell, at least one immediate neighbour must prevent it from being greater than all neighbours.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_06/ch_03. The student must decide: Choose numbers so that exactly the intended cells become supercells. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
